definitions.explanation: remembering something incorrectly; a mistaken recollection

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{記憶|きおく}{違|ちが}いだった。
⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{記憶|きおく}{違|ちが}い⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I had misremembered the date of the appointment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{記憶|きおく}{違|ちが}いでなければ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧さんだった⟦はず→はず：01557_hazu⟧だ。
examples.english: If I'm not misremembering, his name should have been Tanaka.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧ (memory) + ⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧ (difference/mistake). Specifically means remembering facts incorrectly — the memory itself is wrong, not that you forgot.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {記憶|きおく}{違|ちが}いだった: it was a faulty memory
- {記憶|きおく}{違|ちが}いでなければ: if I'm not misremembering
- {記憶|きおく}{違|ちが}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to misremember

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{勘違|かんちが}い→勘違い：17609_kanchigai⟧: misunderstanding, misconception (broader — covers misunderstanding in general)
- ⟦{思|おも}い{違|ちが}い→思い違い：08583_omoichigai⟧: mistaken thought, wrong assumption
- ⟦ど{忘|わす}れ→ど忘れ：17611_dowasure⟧: sudden memory lapse (tip-of-the-tongue — you know it but can't recall)
- ⟦{物忘|ものわす}れ→物忘れ：17610_monowasure⟧: forgetfulness (general tendency, often associated with aging)

USAGE:
{記憶|きおく}{違|ちが}い is relatively neutral and non-blaming. It acknowledges that memory can be unreliable without implying negligence.
